Naturalist and storyteller exploring what makes every living thing extraordinary. The Infinite Biosphere.

If you'd like to sponsor an Infinite Biosphere episode, reach out at the email below.

Stephanie Sammann is a science communicator and filmmaker who creates in-depth videos about the living world — from animal minds and strange anatomy to the smallest, weirdest insects and the most formidable predators on Earth. She has been described as “the girl who can make shrimp cool." Stephanie collaborates with academics and conservationists around the world to translate complex science into accessible, curiosity-driven stories that bring audiences closer to the natural world.

Previously, Stephanie was the creator and host of Real Science.

stephanie@infinitebiosphere.com
